src: marker pixels outside the solid 2x2 foreground block
path: straight row, column, or 45-degree diagonal path inward toward the 2x2 block, stopping at the adjacent ring cell on the same side or corner
trajectory: move each marker pixel to its stopping cell
dst: one-cell ring around the solid 2x2 block
transform: clear the original marker positions and keep the 2x2 block fixed
